definition: Across the 81 tribulations, the demons of Xiyouji reveal 5 crime methods — from 'transformation fraud' to 'team siege' — with method tier positively correlated with treasure tier.

representative_cases: White Bone Demon's three transformations (village girl / old woman / old man) to win Tang Sanzang's trust
Golden Horn and Silver Horn transform into old priests · disguised as monks to infiltrate the monastery
Yellow Robe Demon transforms into a handsome young man · deceiving the princess of Precious Elephant Kingdom
Six-eared Macaque transforms into Sun Wukong · usurping the scripture-seeking team
Silver Horn the Great transforms into an old priest · tricking Wukong into carrying a mountain
crime_types.target_pattern: Tang Sanzang's mortal-eyes trust · the cognitive blind spot within the scripture-seeking team
crime_types.key_insight: Transformation demons are 'information-gap' criminals · profiting through disguise and information asymmetry

representative_cases: Black Bear Demon steals the cassock · looting amid chaos
Yellow Wind Demon forcibly abducts Tang Sanzang into his cave
the Great King of Linggan freezes the Tongtian River to seize people
Yellow Robe Demon directly seizes a bride · coercion by force
Nine-headed Insect steals the Buddha relic (śarīra)
crime_types.target_pattern: Tang Sanzang's flesh / treasures / wealth · aiming to overpower through force
crime_types.key_insight: Force-type demons are 'brute-force' criminals · easy to identify but hard to overpower

representative_cases: Scorpion Demon forces marriage at Pipa Cave · trying to break Tang Sanzang's chastity
Seven Spider Demon Sisters seduce at the Zhuogou Spring
Rat Demon forces marriage at the Bottomless Cave
Jade Rabbit Demon, as a false princess of Tianzhu, solicits a marriage
Apricot Fairy lures with poetry at Thorn Ridge
crime_types.target_pattern: Tang Sanzang's chastity · breaking the pilgrim's virgin body to gain immortality
crime_types.key_insight: Seduction demons are 'soft-power' criminals · low success rate but Tang Sanzang repeatedly nears breaking his vows

representative_cases: Red Boy's Samādhi True Fire · nearly burns Wukong to death
Green Ox Demon's Diamond Bracelet sucks away all weapons
Dapeng's Yin-Yang Two-Energy Bottle · traps victims and dissolves them
Yellow-browed Demon's golden cymbals and Human-seed Pouch
Hundred-eyed Demon Lord's thousand-eye golden light · traps Wukong
crime_types.target_pattern: suppressing the scripture-seeking team with exclusive magic / treasures · forcing them to seek outside help
crime_types.key_insight: Magic demons are 'technical-barrier' criminals · only breakable by finding the original owner or a counter-treasure

representative_cases: Three demons of Lion-Camel Ridge (Green Lion / White Elephant / Dapeng) fight in coordination
Three demons of Chechi Kingdom (Tiger Strength / Deer Strength / Goat Strength) in magical contests
Nine-headed Son-in-law of Bibo Pool + the Dragon King family of Wansheng
Eighteen Lords of Thorn Ridge + Apricot Fairy and other tree spirits
Seven Spider Demons of Pansi Cave in coordination
crime_types.target_pattern: multiple demons cooperating · clear division of labor · measured offense and defense
crime_types.key_insight: Team demons are 'organized' criminals · weak individually but strong in coordination · must be defeated one by one

pattern_insights: The 5 crime methods correspond to 5 demon strategies · a gradient from 'technical' to 'physical'
Transformation Fraud is hard to detect · but is specifically countered by Wukong's Fiery Eyes
Forceful Plunder is the most common but has the lowest success rate · a 'low-tech, high-volume' crime
Seduction specifically targets Tang Sanzang's chastity · only 10% success rate · but greatest psychological threat
Magic Threat has the highest success rate · revealing the essence of Xiyouji's 'technical barrier = survival barrier'
Team Siege represents demon organization · the three demons of Lion-Camel are the highest form of demon organization
